system.description:
An Awakened animal that can take human form. Modifiers: Human +1 Body, +1 Strength. Animal +5 Body, −1 Quickness, +5 Strength, −2 Willpower, +1 Reach, Dermal Armor (+2 Body). Race must be Priority A, on the Shapeshifter Character Creation Table (B: magician, C: adept). Base Attributes may not exceed 6; the form modifiers then apply with no racial maximum. Shifting is a Complex Action; gear doesn't shift. In animal form: no speech or Social skills, spells but no Centering, no adept powers. Dual-natured. Regenerates in animal form; Severe Allergy and Vulnerability to silver; rejects cyberware; no free starting contacts.

Shadowrun Companion p.36–38
